notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Patch #5
notes.content:
Hey everyone.

I have been working hard on Galactic Mining Corp and have been listening to the awesome feedback from the forums, discord and reviews (good and bad) and have made some changes and additions I hope you will enjoy!

Here is whats in this patch
[list]
[*] Added - 7 new completionist medals added with BIG STAT PRIZES. These can also be viewed in Office.
    [olist]
[*] All the Cores - Drill every core in the game
[*]     Coretrium Complete - Complete the Coretrium
[*]     All the Crew - Obtain and max level all crew
[*]     Champion Explorer - Uncover all maps
[*]     Upgrade all Items - ... all items upgraded
[*]     Research Genius - Complete all research squares
[*]     Material Master - Upgrade all tiles [/olist]
[*] Added - New monster - Blockhead
[*] Added - Breaking a chest has a chance of releasing a TREASURE BONSON!!
[*] Added - MONSTER INFESTATION DETECTED! Some drill sites are now infested! (lots of monsters)
[*] Added - Some drill sites are now Swiss cheesed! (Lots of gaps)
[*] Added - Nano Drills now give XP for both tiles and Items they bring back

[*] Fixed - Auto drilling movement getting stuck on things
[*] Fixed - Correct number of rooms available now shown in Room Upgrade UI list.
[*] Fixed - Issue with some flavour text disappearing in galaxy map
[*] Fixed - Issue with option menu not displaying correctly
[*] Fixed - Typos and grammar errors

[*] Changed - Re balanced late game progress and reduced grind
[*] Changed - Reduced XP requirements of end game tile upgrades
[*] Changed - Decrease the difficulty of planet Apollo
[*] Changed - Tweaks to many drill location stats
[*] Changed - Nano drill cool-down reduced
[*] Changed - Nano drills have a better chance of finding rarer materials
[*] Changed - Monsters can spawn closer to each other and in more random ways
[/list] 
[b]HOTFIXES/CHANGES SINCE PATCH[/b]---------------------------------------

[b]HOTFIX [/b]- A few people may have been able to get INFINITE DRILL POWER due to an exploit in this patch! This has now been addressed. 

[b]HOTFIX [/b]- An issue was identified where nano drills were causing items to level up incorrectly. This has now been fixed.

[b]HOTFIX 28.07.21 [/b]- A few people caught a bug in which they could not get the final item upgrade achievement (with item upgrade numbers exceeding total in game). This has now been addressed. Pressing the "Sync" button in the achievements screen of the office should provide the missing achievement. This only affected a handful of people caught between the major patch release and the hot fix later that day and only those who used nano drills in this short period of time.

[b]HOTFIX 30.07.21 [/b]- Monster infestations have been reduced slightly across all infested locations.

[b]HOTFIX 06.08.21 [/b]- Monster infestations have been reduced again to a more manageable level. I very much appreciate the feedback I have received about these. 

[b]HOTFIX 06.08.21 [/b]-  For those who caught the item level bug. I have added a fix as best I could to help your save file. If you go to the office/achievement screen and press the sync button it should now return your item levels to the correct max and it SHOULD pop the Item completion badge and perk. You will also be awarded a load of drill tokens as this issue would have meant you could not get them all. Please let me know if this helps you. Its very difficult to test this as the issue was such a small window of time and didn't affect many people. I wanted to fix this as I feel those who were affected deserve better and I made a mistake. I hope this will fix the issue for those that were affected and I hope you are enjoying Galactic Mining Corp
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This is quite a large update and I hope you find the changes and additions even more fun. I am so thankful for all the amazing support I have received for the game and I hope many of you will continue to enjoy the game long into the future.

Happy drilling and much love

Anthony
windybeard

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Patch #4
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I have been working hard to make Galactic Mining Corp even greater! Thanks to your amazing feedback and suggestions I have added another set of fixes and additions.

Here is whats in this patch...
[list]
[*] [b]Added a second control method[/b]. Several users with hand related injuries/problems have stated that extended play causes them discomfort. I want to do everything I can to make Galactic Mining Corp fun for everyone. Now you can switch to "Auto drill" mode in the options menu. This will make the drill automatically follow the mouse, when the left mouse button is held down you will stop until you release the button.
[*] [b]Crit strike has had a make over[/b]. Hitting a crit will now cause damage to some surrounding tiles in front of your drill. A crit strike will cause (base drill damage + crit damage) to the tile being drilled and crit damage to surrounding tiles. This affects tiles, crates and chests!
[*] You can now hit crit strikes on chests and crates.
[*] Crit stike chance increased by 30%. You will see many more of them. I also increased the size of the crit strike visual effect.
[*] [b]New Tooltip added [/b]. You can now mouse over tiles and items in the end of mission screen to see the names of the tiles and items.
[*] A large amount of optimisation should reduce frame rate issues when drilling large planets with tons of powerups.
[*] Reduced the cost of Mighty Obelisk of Research investment site by a considerable amount. 
[*] Fixed an issue where having to much money made your cash turn negative. Capped at 2 Billion.
[*] Fixed the confusing wording of the Sunset Silo. It now refers to crit damage in its description.
[*] Fixed several sound effects not applying the player chose SFX volume
[*] Fixed a strange issue causing some chests to be empty in the explore screen
[*] Corrected a load of spelling mistakes
[*] Fixed an issue where giant worm would spawn twice in same place.
[/list]
[b]Hotfix (later the same day)[/b] - Anyone who had their cash turn negative before the above patch should now be pulled back into the positive when first entering the HQ screen. Sorry to anyone who got stuck in negative for a while. I hope this is now fixed for you all.

Again I want to thank you all for the most amazing release. Its been an absolute joy speaking with you all about the game and its amazing to see how much people are enjoying the game. Thank you!!!

Happy drilling and much love

Anthony
Windybeard

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Patch #3
notes.content:
Hey everyone. 

Alongside the launch of the Galactic Mining Corp Steam trading cards I have managed to update quite a lot in the game itself. Some fixes and a few new additions!

[list]
[*] The infirmary level 3 upgrade no longer costs a BAJILLION coins. It now has a reasonable price.
[*] More work on the sound effects volume issue. I am hopeful it should now apply chosen volumes to sound effects (including muted)
[*] Music will no longer be interrupted/silenced by lots of explosions.
[*] Coretrium 3rd final node changed from a xp boost to a Research coin drop increase. (this will sadly not be applied if you have already unlocked it)
[*] Late game drilling earnings will be updated correctly when numbers get really high.
[*] Upgrading tiles/items to max will no longer randomly leave the "level up" button visible.
[*] Horizontal explosive crates now kill monsters.
[*] fixed another load of typo's and grammar issues. 
[*] Fixed a rare issue in which 1 research square was not unlocking correctly
[*] Fixed an issue with a block break sound effect not playing every time
[*] Fixed an issue where unlocking space map squares behaved strangely (on rare occasions) in 3rd map bottom corner.

[*] Added a 5x green coin to reduce late game slow down due to coin and particle loads.
[*] Added a new investment site in 3rd galaxy. GO FIND IT
[*] Added a Sync button on the in game achievement screen which will resync with steam and unlock any achievements missed by Steam (you have to have them unlocked in that save file for Steam to find them)
[*] Added A currency larger than the blue gems for super hardcore grinders!
[/list]
Thank you all so very much for the amazing support. the last few weeks since release have been an absolute roller coaster! I sincerely hope you are all enjoying the game. Feel free to join the Windybeard Discord to discuss the game (or anything) and throw around some suggestions. I am in there most of the time. [url=https://discord.gg/FKumdQY]Join the Windybeard Discord[/url]

After the last patch a few people noticed a slow down, after a quick system restart it was gone so be sure to do this if you experience anything similar. If you are one of the unfortunate few who has had their Antivirus wipe their save files, please be sure to white list Galactic Mining Corp again after this patch just in case. I am still trying to address this issue.

[h3]Happy Drilling![/h3]

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Patch #2
notes.content:
Hey everyone.

Thanks again for the mind blowing support and very helpful feedback about the game. I am reading and trying my best to respond to as much as I can. 

[h1]Whats new?[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sound effects should no longer play when SFX volume is set to zero and should also all play at the correct volume level
[*] Fixed a boosting bug where even when stationary boost points would be used
[*] Increased the size of the HQ panning control so you don't need to touch the very top of the screen
[*] You can now boost damage both chests and power up crates
[*] Changing location in the Astronomy screen while Nano drill loot is being provided no longer makes the items/tiles vanish
[*] Fixed a bug where monsters would get trapped outside the screen or not appear at all
[*] Fixed a bug in which rooms placed directly above the HQ door were behaving strangely when removed and replaced
[*] Tweaked particle creation when drilling again to try and reduced late game chaos lag
[*] Arcade game Banana Drama is now a little easier. Gun overheat takes longer to get and cools down quicker.
[*] Corrected another load of typos 
[*] Fixed an issue in option menu where selection buttons didn't register when clicked 
[/list]

I am very aware of the readability issue some people are experiencing with certain blocks of text, this is being worked on however requires redesign/modification on several user interface elements so will take me a little longer to get that one fixed.

I am also aware a very small number of people are experiencing an issue with save files. It appears Windows defender is being over aggressive in a few rare cases and stopping save files being created without warning the user. A community solution has been posted in the discussions. 

Thanks again for all the amazing support. Know that I am reading all reports and requests and working my way through everything that needs doing to make Galactic Mining Corp the best it can be.

Until the next patch

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Patch #1
notes.content:
Hey everyone. 

Thanks for all the amazing support and feedback about the game. Its been amazing chatting with you all and seeing so many people enjoying the game. 
I have been working day and night to address some small issues and requests raised both in the forums on Steam and in the Windybeard Discord

[h2]Whats new?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pilot perks are now explained inside the Garage screen. When you are in the crew selection screen for the drill you will now see what pilot perk the crew member has AND an explanation of what it does.
[*] Twin Trouble arcade is now a bit easier. Your score will increase a bit faster plus you now have 3 bits of health instead of one.
[*] Lots of spelling and grammar corrections throughout the game.
[*] Coretrium scrolling collider has been increased in size so now you dont have to touch the very top of the screen to pan around
[*] Added a navigation explanation to the Coretrium
[*] Removed confusing art assets from the Coretrium that signalled to players that you can pan left and right. (Will be adding new art instead soon)
[*] Initial sound settings are reduced in the options menu to a lower volume. 
[*] Inconsistent room XP modifier information has been fixed.
[*] Reduced the height you can pan to in the HQ to a more accurate height.
[*] Fixed some issues with coin generation when drilling
[*] Addressed a rare banana drama game crash bug
[*] Fixed an issue with research particles being over produced. 
[*] Likely some other stuff I forgot to write down.
[/list]

There will be another patch soon. I am frequently checking all forum posts and discord messages and am aware of a few outstanding issues that may take a little longer to fix. Know that I am working on them as fast as I can.

Thank you all again for the amazing support. I am pretty gobsmacked by the reception of Galactic Mining Corp. Be sure to leave a review on Steam and have fun out there, may the planets be stuffed with gold.... and maybe apples/alarm clocks.

Until the next patch

Much Love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - RELEASE DATE SET
notes.content:
Hey everyone

This will be the final development update post, as [b]I can now announce the release date for Galactic Mining Corp![/b]

First up, over the last few weeks I have worked on squashing over 200 bugs and issues identified by my amazing team of testers who have spent collectively[b] thousands of hours[/b] playing the game through over and over again. In particular, I'd like to thank my good pal RetroSteezy for his incredible dedication to meticulously pulling apart my game over hundreds of hours of playtime - cheers, mate! :D

Alongside all this bug fixing has been more polishing and some late-game balancing, which has been both difficult and time-consuming, but important to the overall experience. In my last update I told you that Lana_Lux had voiced Kira, the tutorial bot. She is now joined by Galactic Mining Corp's character artist, Peet Cooper, as the voice of Hogan the hangar dude. And of course, I am voicing the dodgy market seller slime alien. My thanks go to both Lana and Peet for helping bring those two characters to life.

But anyway, now onto the bit you've been waiting for. As many of you know, one of my gamedev heroes is Shigeru Miyamoto and I think one of his past quotes sums up my feelings on Galactic Mining Corp: [i]A delayed game is eventually good. A bad game is bad forever.[/i] Galactic Mining Corp has been in development for close to two years and represents the largest investment of time I have made in any of my seven games to date. However, as I have said in the Kickstarter and the various updates, I truly believe it has been worth it. Thank you all for your patience with the release date announcement, and so with that...

[h2]Galactic Mining Corp officially releases on Tuesday 18th May 2021.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8410cc57aee6cde44ff1e389071ce3596bbae4a8.jpg[/img]

For those of you who pledged in the "New Recruit" or higher Kickstarter reward tiers, [b]details of fulfilment applicable to each tier will be posted prior to release.[/b]

I'll finish with another big thank you to everyone for their amazing support and helping me to bring the full Galactic Mining Corp vision into reality.

Much love,  

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #14
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

As even the world's richest people know all too well, launching on particular day is never a guarantee. Circumstances outside your control can upset even the best laid plans, and that is why I have unfortunately had a [b]small slip in my release window[/b]. In the last update a few weeks ago, I had anticipated being able to formally announce the GMC release date sometime around mid-late March 2021. [b]I am sorry to say this is going to be delayed by a few more weeks[/b].

Now, first up the game itself is pretty much done. The art and music is in. The balancing has been tweaked. All the custom content is finished. The bonus in-game arcade cartridges are ready. What has happened is that [b]my planned house move has been delayed[/b], which has skewered my original release schedule and forced a small shift in my milestone dates.

[i]"But Windy, why move house and try to release a game at the same time, YOU FOOL!"[/i], I hear you cry. Well, it was never intended for the two to coincide with one another, but COVID-19 and UK Stamp Duty (house move tax) have conspired to generate some delays with the buyers and sellers involved in my moving process which I have zero control over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/c6e9a229631421e9da92e17f82446f07964ce0cd.png[/img]

In order for the GMC release to be a success, I need to have a number of key things in place so that I can support community engagement, deal with bug reports, marketing queries etc which I simply can't do properly in the middle of a house move with all of my stuff in boxes. [b]I am working hard to get the contract and logistics resolved ASAP[/b]. Once I have a confirmed exchange date for house contracts, I will know when I will be in the new place and setup ready to launch. 

I want you all to know that I am not sat here idle - [b]I am using this additional time to keep adding improvements[/b] to the game, including some [b]new animations for the HQ[/b], plus also some [b]new character voice overs[/b] which add yet more depth and colour to the GMC. Kira, the tutorial bot, is now voiced by fellow Twitch streamer and game dev [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lana_lux]Lana Lux[/url]

[b]I expect to have an update on the GMC release date in the next few weeks[/b], once the timeline on my house move and exchange dates are all confirmed. [b]Thanks for your patience[/b] at this rather stressful time.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/windybeardgames]Twitch[/url] | [url=https://discord.gg/FKumdQY]Discord[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/WindybeardGames]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/windybeardgames/]Instagram[/url] | [url=https://www.facebook.com/Windybeard.games]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://www.patreon.com/Windybeardgames]Patreon[/url] | [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Windybeard]Steam[/url] | [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6QtH3K4Ndt2AUXymy5U6gQ]Youtube[/url]

Much love,

Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #13
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

It's a brand new year and I am really pleased to report that [b]all of the crew members and HQ rooms are now finished and have been integrated into the game[/b]. Most of the artwork is now also done, with a few remaining larger static pieces for the Investment Sites still to go. I am growing the GMC universe every day with the backer content and it is shaping up really nicely. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/cc72c37a9c56a3eab8858a00f4f7ce7f88259498.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8b2f0ace7682846baf22f1a6f9ece3b4dcd39255.png[/img]

Further to extensive feedback from alpha testers, it became clear that the additional fourth galaxy was skewing the progression and spacing out the game content too far to be enjoyable. For this reason, I have decided to axe the fourth galaxy and re-structure things - the number of planets and locations will be the same, but in three galaxies rather than four. At the time the stretch goal of the fourth galaxy was created it was not anticipated that play would be negatively impacted, but this is part of the development process and we have to learn from it and respond accordingly - I don't want it to spoil the game, but rest assured that the actual content that would have been in the fourth galaxy is not being axed.

Over the next few weeks I will be addressing a number of bugs from the alpha testers and getting fixes integrated ahead of the release candidate testing. I will also be finalising those remaining Investment Site art pieces and polishing up the last bits of content.

I'll wrap up this update with some very exciting news: Based on current timeline, [b]I expect to finish development of the game by around March 2021, with the intention to release it soon after[/b]. We're so very nearly there and I am doing my best to get it to you as soon as possible. I will make a full announcement regarding the release date in the next 6-8 weeks or so.

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

For those of you who have been tuning into my Twitch livestreams, you will have seen some great progress over the last few weeks. I am really pleased to tell you that [b]all of the HQ rooms are now complete[/b], as are most of the backer content rewards. HQ rooms include saunas, dark matter reactors, meditation gardens, and even an animal rescue centre. Here are some more examples of the new rooms you can build in your HQ building:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/f449c8d4b8dd640b382f5b1aeaac95fd61b74c1a.png[/img]

Peet has been also working tirelessly on the crew character portraits, which have turned out beyond amazing. From fire-breathing space giraffe to a smug 1980s business guy who loves showing people his watch, there has been a [b]huge variety of wacky crew lining up to join your mining corporation[/b] once you complete their in-game crew contract! Here are some of the latest additions to the crew roster:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/facfd2e54af9f943aabc6db364744249ce1593a7.png[/img]

These have been some [b]really important milestones[/b] that I was really determined to hit before Christmas and I am very happy to achieved them. Going into the new year, I have some of the larger individual art pieces such as the Investment Sites to work on, and then lots more testing and polishing ahead of release. I also have some [b]cool announcements coming up about collaboration and cross-over with other game universes[/b] which I hope you'll find as exciting as I do... stay tuned for more.

In closing, I wish you all a very Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year. See you in 2021!

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #10
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png[/img]
[i]Geo 2 has been renamed as Galactic Mining Corp[/i]

Hey everyone!

As we reach the end of November, it has been a very intense few weeks here at the studio. There has been lots of testing and refinements on systems and mechanics across the whole of Geo 2. From tweaking progression in the Coretrium to adjusting the fine-grained stats for drills and bonuses, a huge amount of effort has gone in to get things balanced so that you have [b]the most enjoyable experience[/b] when mining for your galactic fortunes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/b786d58889b26e40780868c30098f6bdc4019be5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/47b71b596e30485b0075504ba11733db5e55402c.jpg[/img]

We know that players love being able to show off their skills and determination, so there are now [b]over 100 unlockable achievements[/b] going into the game to track and celebrate your progress! There are a wide variety of achievements, with simple goals as well more challenging ones for the most demanding of gamers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/e64397fa6828e5f2be4a8f821a540af74c93bf07.jpg[/img]

We now move into December where [b]work continues on the content and art[/b] for Geo 2. In particular, Peet and I will be focusing on the remaining Kickstarter backer content rewards. Most of the planets, items, and space traffic are now complete - we have got some wild and wacky stuff in there! For those backers in the VP Human Resources reward tier, Peet has already reached out to most of you regarding your character designs and we have seen some incredible suggestions being brought to life. I can't wait to see these crew in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/73cf654183db1198be3e6fac475d71ec041be76c.jpg[/img]

As the temperatures plummet here in the UK and winter settles in, over the next couple of months the game will get its remaining sets of art assets, data content, mechanics tweaks, and final polish. There will also be an updated game trailer coming soon, showcasing many of the improvements. It has been a long road for Geo 2, but I believe the end result will be well worth it. It's a game that I will be immensely proud of and one which I hope will bring an enormous amount of enjoyment to you and all the backers -[b]it couldn't have got to this level without you[/b].

You can still find me regularly streaming game development and art over on Twitch, please do drop by if you'd like a look at how it's all coming together - I'd love to see you there.

Expect another update and exciting sneak peeks before Christmas.

Much love,
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Galactic Mining Corp - Development Update #9
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/67948c78e85137b8d84530a7a4bbdd3b47c022ce.png[/img]
[i]Geo 2 has been renamed as Galactic Mining Corp[/i]

[b]Hey everyone[/b]

So much has happened with both Geo 2 and my other games since the last update. Rest assured I am working on Geo 2 every single day and doing my very best to make Geo 2 the sequel to remember! So enough words Windybeard, tell me what you have done!

[h1]Effects and Polish[/h1]
Now this is one of my favourite stages of a games development. Now that I am fast approaching the later stages of development I have been replacing, updating and polishing everything that needs it. Little tweaks to explosions, small visual effects, colour changes and rearranging things that didn't quite feel right. The list of these small jobs is too long to list here but after several weeks of this the game has leapt forward in terms of quality.  Below are a few screenies that show some of these updates and effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/314ebc227a164acf312c450370d856c185af3070.png[/img]

[h1]Caves and variety[/h1]
I have started ramping up the variety and events you can find while drilling. One of my intents with Geo 2 is to give you all the sense of never really knowing what to expect when drilling toward the core. Even after many hours of play I want you to find new things to interact with, run from and even laugh at. I have added lots of new “cave events” to find. These are small random things you can find, some help you, some don't but they are never negative. There are common ones and rare ones. The rare “cave events” can be super useful. Here is a fun one to have a peep at.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/e3edcc7521aa2d7c0c8a35f467700d35fd5500e4.gif[/img]

[h1]Kickstarter art[/h1]
For the Geo 2 Kickstarter I offered backers the opportunity to purchase different assets in the game such as rooms, planets and even crew members. Here are some of the new assets I designed based on the awesome ideas of the Kickstarter backers. It was awesome to see how creative people can be and some of the ideas were genuinely amusing. Here are some of the planets the crazy Kickstarter backers came up with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8b39d49e209501cd7ab64bb2b29fe41fb9aab6e2.png[/img]

[h1]Bugs smashing[/h1]
As with the polish stage I detailed above, I have now moved head first into the pulsating belly of the bug beast. Every little annoyance, every little mistake or bug is being chronicled and obliterated. Its a challenging, often annoying but very satisfying part of late stage development. Still a few to go but its really starting to come together now.

[h1]Puzzle Plunder Vampire Night DLC[/h1]
As some of you have seen I have released a Vampire themed expansion DLC for my FREE to play match 3 game Puzzle Plunder. Puzzle Plunder Vampire Nights is out now so if you fancy checking it out please do so.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1445800/Puzzle_Plunder__Vampire_Night/

[h1]Halloween Sale[/h1]
Every game of mine is currently heavilly discounted for the Steam Halloween sale! Upto 75% off everything. Check them out and if you fancy grabbing one then I would appreciate that very much.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/6139/Windybeard_Complete_Collection/

Thanks again for the ongoing support for Geo 2 and all my other games. It really is appreciated! Also while I have you here, please consider leaving a short review for any of my games if you own them and even if you dont own them, consider leaving a short review for another indie developer. They mean so much and are often a glimmer of light in the ever swelling waves of Steams algorithmic uncertainties.

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/b03db6769df59851b8ab18ed6b87d04f5ebaffbd.png[/img]

Hey everyone

There has been loads of great stuff happening with Geo 2 over the past few weeks. Heres whats been going down in Geo town!

[h1]Kickstarter[/h1]
As you may have seen the Geo 2 Kickstarter was a roaring success! It was fully funded in under 5 hours and finished at around 250% funded, achieving 2 stretch goals! This means that Geo 2 will now have an extra galaxy to explore, there will be hidden arcade mini games to find and play in the galaxy maps that will unlock cool stuff and thirdly you will be able to send nano drills off to bring you resources!! Wooo!

A big part of the Kickstarter campaign was to allow people to put their own stamp on the universe by designing planets, rooms, investment sites and more. I am now getting back the information from the amazing backers as to what they would like and OH MY MY... we have some awesomely weird and wonderful things going into the Geo 2 universe! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/109c8ed84c891a68ae9b97afb0859ebc86e1ebd6.png[/img]

[h1]Environment art[/h1]
At the top of every planet in Geo 2 is a nice slither of art, the ground level of that planet. I have been furiously designing these assets and I absolutely love drawing alien landscapes. There will be a ton of variety throughout the planets and hopefully these will help build that feeling of descending into a strange alien planet. Here is a few of the designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/81683d3df087aa248207abb2354e0cf61f8272e8.png[/img]

[h1]Drills[/h1]
I have now designed all of the drill components for Geo 2. As you play through the game you will unlock new drill heads and drill bodies. These are inter-changeable so you can build a drill that best suits your play style! Each has its own stats that can be upgraded and all the components have their own strengths and weaknesses.

Each drill piece was designed in a large version for the HQ and the Garage and also a smaller animated one for when you are drilling and scooting about in space. The graphics change depending on your choice. Additionally each drill body has its own coloured trail when you fly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8b6d486d82246c39342972bb632a03607e6285e3.png[/img]

[h1]Arcades[/h1]
As stated above there are now arcade mini games to find throughout the universe. If you can beat certain high scores you will unlock some really cool prizes (like the changdable HQ backgrounds)
The first game is “Mr Banihans Banana Drama”. As with Geo 2 itself the game is played entirely with the mouse. Left click to shoot and right click to change lanes. Avoid the evil vegetable monsters and drop off bananas for points!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/74ea15025155b543c85b45eceadfe05cda8e2eea.png[/img]

[h1]UI/HQ Update[/h1]
A large job I recently completed was to modify every single UI and the entire HQ with damage, marks, scuffs and patches. It was a large undertaking but one I feel gives the entire game a much more “industrial” vibe. An intergalactic mining corporation run by strange aliens wouldn't be pristine and well kept now would it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/1f1c1c6bb140dcbd89ee51ddb63d837690192d55.jpg[/img]

Whats next? I have a lot of art to do! I am chipping away at the mountain as fast as I can and rest assured, Geo 2 will be here soon and it will be all the better for all this extra love.

[url=https://www.twitch.tv/windybeardgames]Twitch[/url] | [url=https://discord.gg/FKumdQY]Discord[/url] | [url=https://twitter.com/WindybeardGames]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/windybeardgames/]Instagram[/url] | [url=https://www.facebook.com/Windybeard.games]Facebook[/url] | [url=https://www.patreon.com/Windybeardgames]Patreon[/url] | [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Windybeard]Steam[/url] | [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6QtH3K4Ndt2AUXymy5U6gQ]Youtube[/url]

Thanks for reading!

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png[/img]

Hey everyone

Its been a good few weeks since the last update however please be assured I am working endlessly on Geo 2 to make it the best game It can be. Here is some new stuff!

[h3]HQ Customisation[/h3]
AS you play through Geo 2 you will be able to increase the size of your HQ which allows you to build more rooms, you will also be able to unlock different locations to have your HQ such as an arctic tundra or a volcanic cliff top. There will be many more of these to unlock as you play through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/1c235f86fbf103915eeb3bd57f737628460d4545.gif[/img]

[h3]Crates[/h3]
As you drill you will find crates which contain special power-ups and abilities. When the game starts you can only find a handful of these crates however as you explore space you will recover stock for the market place, one of the main stock types you will find are new power-up crates. Buying these from the store will unlock the crate and it will begin to appear at random throughout the games drilling sites. Here are a few of the crates you can find. (There will be LOTS of crates to unlock)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/83abdef026a55b3418aa00ebf41ba6880b3a530f.png[/img]

[h3]Kira - Tutorial[/h3]
Meet “Kira” your new and improved Geo assistant robot.  She will guide you through setting up your Business and step you through some of the basics when you first start playing. She can also be called at anytime from the help menu and explain in detail the many aspects of the game and for those who go in deep with the game she will break down some of the advanced techniques and mathematics behind the games systems.

For those who don't like tutorials she can be just told to go away and you can figure it all out for yourself.

She isn't quite finished yet but she will be soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/c3f985f84f5e7ad8696e04636e597fe17a349946.png[/img]

[h3]Sound and music[/h3]
While I cannot show this in a image or Gif I can tell you that most of the music and sound is now in place and it is great! Injekted (Dude who does all the Windybeard music) has outdone himself with this OST.  32 unique, smooth chillout DnB for you to drill too! If you played Geo 1 then expect that OST but on a whole new level! The OST will also be available as a DLC and will have full soundtrack plus album edits of each track for a total of 64 tracks!

[h3]Kickstarter[/h3]
This is still in the process of being finalised, When it launches (Hopefully very soon) I will give you plenty of notice to jump in and check it out. There will be some great ways to support the game and place your own stamp on many aspects of the game from designing planets to crafting your own crew members!

[h3]Other Stuff[/h3]
Outside of all this I have been working on less exciting aspects of the game such as bug fixing, balance and content data entry. While not explosively entertaining it is amazing to sit back and see the progress on Geo 2 and I can tell you now that if you enjoyed Geo 1 then you are going to love Geo 2!

I am honoured to have a very talented artist PEET involved and assisting with Geo 2. He is super talented and has worked on some of the greatest games in the world! He is designing the characters for Geo 2 (and some other cool stuff). Check out this image he is currently working on for Geo 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/b50f5e904c0c39287c70457bdf3ec04ade3e19a6.png[/img]

Thank you all so much for reading and your patience with Geo 2's development. It will be released soon I promise!

[h3]10% of sales of Geo 2 will go to the gaming charity "Gamers For Good".[/h3]https://gamersforgood.com/

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png[/img]

Hey everyone

Geo 2 development is pressing ahead nicely . Since the last update a large amount of art work has been completed. Pretty much 2 weeks of solid art and design.

[h3]Tiles[/h3]
Last update I spoke about the tile designs and my progress (72 tiles completed) I have now completed all 120 tile designs for Geo 2 WOOHOO. Its a massive content milestone and I am happy with how they turned out. Its no easy feat to design 120 unique tiles that are interesting and colourful. Here is 6 more tiles to look at!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/5e955c1e752dbdb1c945ed76c3a452b9a1714319.png[/img]

[h3]Points of interest[/h3]
I have also completed the design of a few new “points of interest” scenes. I showed an unfinished design last update so here is that scene finished. I really enjoy the process of making these POI's and hope to have some really interesting locations to find and funny stories to enjoy that will really make the Geo 2 universe feel alive and full of fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/5fe973a2b04248e0c5a5417fec166945000f1a4c.png[/img]

[h3]Geo 2 Headquarters (HQ)[/h3]
I have been designing the actual Geo 2 HQ building. When you upgade your HQ in the coretrium it grows in size by 2 rooms. Each level of the HQ is hand designed and builds up a unique and interesting building like no other. Here is the current piece I am working on (Lvl 8 HQ)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/98f96165c53fed3f27dc074bce90e887a083037f.png[/img]

[h3]Options[/h3]
Outside of the vast amount of art work being completed I have been working through a truly huge “to do” list of tiny features, quality of life changes and all round game play tweaks to make Geo 2 more fun, accessible and pleasant to play. This includes options to removed screen shake, reduce particle and effects, provide visual cash drop values and damage counters etc and much more. There will plenty of options available for  you to tailor Geo 2 to your own tastes and needs. I am eager to hear of any options that would help you enjoy Geo 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/0d9d4b15a7f89f2acc6ab075f90649cbfc2ea446.png[/img]

[h3]Kickstarter[/h3]
I am currently building a small Kickstarter campaign to raise a little funding to push Geo 2 that bit further. Geo 2 will be released regardless of the campaigns success however if I can get the small campaign successful it will really help push Geo 2 further and make it even better! Watch this space for more info on this when the time comes and I hope I can count on your support!
Not only will you be able to pre order a copy of Geo 2, there will be tons of cool backer rewards up for grabs and some really great ways to get involved with aspects of the game and put your stamp on it!

[h3]Physical Stuff[/h3]
I am also in the process of creating and designing some awesome physical Geo 2 stuff. Its very early days however It is something that is in the works and I hope its gonna be awesome. I will again update you all with their progress and when the time comes how you can get your hands on these exclusive Geo 2 (and other Windybeard) physical products.

Thank you so much for reading and I hope you are looking forward to Geo 2.

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/9e4d07ce64aa2e10973c143df09ae9e360e7535d.png[/img]

Hey everyone

Lots of work has been happening with Geo 2. Most of this work is lots of tiny modifications and bug fixing. One of the biggest changes since the last update was the new Geo 2 Logo. Below you can see both the new and old Logo designs.
[h3]New logo[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/9be40e274e484d7714d5cc09247c07f52cd86965.png[/img]
[h3]Tiles[/h3]
I have also been designing many of the tiles that will fill the worlds in Geo 2. At the time of writing this I have completed 72 Tiles. I plan to have a huge assortment of tiles to bring a great variety to the worlds you drill. Each tile has its own stats and information and every single tile can be leveled up in Geo 2. Leveling up a tile will increase its cash value by 50% and also award you with a "Drill Token" each time it is leveled up. You can use those drill tokens to upgrade your drill components. Here is a few of my favourite tiles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/4b92c83f2a97b9f857206651630e8f92817d00d4.png[/img]
[h3]Monsters[/h3]
I have also been designing and adding new monsters. In Geo 1 monsters appeared randomly throughout the drill sites. In Geo 2 monster appearance is slightly different. They will still appear randomly throughout the planets however they are preset to specific planets. For example the Giant worm may only appear on certain planets instead of all of them. This allows me to create far more variety and hopefully some fun and amusing surprises. 
Many of the monsters have returned from Geo 1 (BONSON!!!) and many more new ones. Here is one of the many new monsters. This guy is called "Bloat"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/414b4b767234161093a660ad8500bb9f56e85ead.gif[/img]
[h3]Points of interest[/h3]
One of the new additions to Geo 2 is the "Point of interest" (POI) that you can find when exploring space. These are bonus locations. They show a hand drawn image of the place you have found, some story and a prize. This has allowed me to really work some more story and Lore into the expansive universe of Geo 2. They are great fun to design however they do take a while to finish. I hope you like them and I think they will add a great depth to the game that was missing from the original.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/929af7b884effcf323ff8f834d10142bdf95bc7c.png[/img]

Here is the current POI I am working on. Alien desert Storage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/053173778a5ed0482ce1ebfaf7f242884e75dfc3.png[/img]
[h3]Dev Tools[/h3]
One of the hardest jobs for me when making this game is actually building the universe and balancing the content within it. There are so many different variables involved with every aspect of the game and one of my most important principles with Geo is to allow the player to explore in any direction they want and deal with the consiquences of that choice. This is a very difficult balancing issue however I am confident I can get it right and make a fun, well balanced yet challenging universe to explore and enjoy.

here is a little sneak peak at the Location database I have built to actually create the planets you drill in the game. Its not pretty but it does the job. There is most likely a large amount of additional data points I will need to add to this tool before its finished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/7e79ac96351e2efbe9f2ade85d8a976df86d4291.png[/img]

A huge amount of art still is yet to be completed for Geo 2 however it is coming along really well and I am happy with its development so far. I will post more incomplete art works and stuff like that as I really dig into this huge art phase. Thank you so much for reading and I hope you are looking forward to playing Geo 2. 

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)

notes.title: Geo 2 - Development Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/516f10d7fb4c5dd7a8439b2a94236338c939419f.png[/img]

Hey everyone

In this update I will shed some light on the exploration system of Geo 2, what sort of things you can find and where Geo 2 improves on Geo 1 in this regard

[h3]Exploration[/h3]
Exploration is a huge part of Geo 2. By exploring you find all manner of awesome, useful and frankly weird things. When you enter a galaxy (of which there are several) you will begin in the centre. You can explore in any direction you wish, there is no set path however the further from the centre you explore the more expensive it gets, the trade off being the further you go the greater the reward

The centre of the galaxy is generally more densely packed however the locations you can find further out will be far harder but considerably more valuable. 

Exploring is super simple, click on a "?" square and right click it to uncover whats underneath (If you have the cash of course), if you are lucky enough to find something BIG it will clear the entire object of "?" squares! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/d0b086a927efb99daeadd5e3f77d2545fcac596d.gif[/img]

The map system is different from Geo 1. In Geo 1 you would pay to unlock small quadrants of space that would have some places to drill and other goodies to find. In Geo 2 the maps are significantly bigger, around 5 times bigger than the biggest map in Geo 1! The new map system is hand designed by me to allow for a much more balanced experience. As you progress through Geo 2 you will unlock new maps with even greater challenge and even better rewards.

[h3]Improvements and new stuff![/h3]
[b]Mini Map[/b] - You now have a mini map of the galaxy to help you move around, as the maps are quite large it is helpful to be able to see what you have found in the area. You can also move around via this mini map by clicking on the objects within it.

[b]Crew Contracts[/b] - A returning feature but greatly improved. You will find crew contracts out in space. When you enter one you will be greeted by a potential new crew member to hire. they have a little story and a request. If you can obtain the objects they desire then they will come and work for you!
Crew contracts are recorded and accessible from any map at any time once you have met the crew member so unlike Geo 1 you will not need to revist them in order to fulfil the request and grab a new crew member! Super useful.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/9245098d99ed01f2b5d059971933ffdc0b302687.png[/img]

[b]Drill Hangars[/b] - A whole new feature in Geo 2. Dotted around the galaxies are drill hangars. The Hangar dude wants key cards and cash to open the hangar and for you to get the new drill component. Hidden around the galaxies are key cards. Collect the amount required and hand over the dosh and the new drill component is yours! 
Your drill is customizable and upgradable in Geo 2 and this is one of the ways you can obtain new parts to use and upgrade! (More on this system in another update)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/27d1b4110b73f37ad836f8fa007ce6019f0f4c40.png[/img]

[b]Points of Interest[/b] - Spread throughout the galaxy are these locations. When you enter one of these you will be given an awesome image of the location and a story to enjoy, you will also get some loot for finding this location and often hints and tips to help you on your adventure. The galaxies of Geo 2 are rich with stories and characters for you to enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37110783/8f9d04bed2525e6dffa42ec1416d7ceadf50a7ee.png[/img]

There is of course lots of drillable locations for you to find, each different and each stuffed full of loot to grab! comets, moons, planets and gas giants return from Geo 1 however now you have a new goliath waiting to be drilled. Have you ever drilled a star core before?

There is much more to find out in the galaxies of Geo 2, and much more to come. You are never far from finding something awesome!

Thank you so very much for your support and for reading. Stay safe

Much love
Anthony (Windybeard)
